summary_zh.motivation: 构建可打印人体尺度组织结构的生物打印系统
summary_zh.method: 集成明胶基生物墨水与PCL支撑材料的打印工艺
summary_zh.result: 成功打印下颌骨、耳朵等结构并实现体内血管化
summary_zh.validation: 小鼠体内植入验证组织存活与血管生成

summary_en.motivation: To develop a 3D bioprinting system capable of producing human-scale tissue constructs with long-term structural integrity.
summary_en.method: A multi-cartridge printer alternating gelatin-based bioink and polycaprolactone support material.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated fabrication of mandible and ear shapes with stable vascularization after implantation.
summary_en.validation: In vivo implantation in mice confirmed tissue survival and blood vessel formation.
